summary_1line: King Dasaratha, troubled by his lack of an heir, resolves to perform the Ashvamedha sacrifice and orders preparations with priests and ministers.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha stands before assembled sages and ministers in his court, declaring his resolve to perform the Ashvamedha sacrifice for a son.
Priests and warriors release the sacred horse to roam freely as the Ashvamedha ritual begins.
The queens of Ayodhya smile with brightened lotus-like faces as King Dasaratha tells them he will perform a sacrifice to obtain a son.
